verdict.rationale: LegalZoom is a SaaS service, so offering event webhooks is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence shows only user-facing alerts, email reminders and real-time compliance notifications. None of it documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks that a programmatic consumer could receive, so these are adjacent notification features, not webhooks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
